bundle.longDescription: Orca Shell is upstream Orca with its Electron shell replaced by Tauri: the window loads the upstream DESKTOP renderer locally and talks through a window.api bridge, while the runtime stays upstream's own orcad — spawned locally in serve mode against the real Orca profile and reached over its paired E2EE channel. Same runtime, same data; only the shell is lighter.
bundle.shortDescription: Orca Shell - desktop renderer in a Tauri shell, upstream orcad runtime
